Context: 12. Assistance to Government servants in legal proceedings

3. Complaints against Secretaries to the Government of India, procedure for handling.cIn order to scrutinize the complaints carefully and to take appropriate action, a group under the Chairmanship of the Cabinet Secretary will take a view on such complaints. If after scrutiny, it is felt that there is some substance in the complaint, the group will decide the nature of investigation and recommend to the Disciplinary Authority for action deemed fit. - GID (3), Rule 19.
